breakdown.description: Ideal-gas law is incorrectly applied to a liquid (water at 20 C).
breakdown.reason: The generated specification directly repeats and even elaborates on the original error, explicitly instructing to use the ideal-gas law (ρ = PM/RT) to calculate the density of liquid water. The ground truth requires treating liquid water as incompressible with ρ ≈ 998 kg/m³ and explicitly states NOT to use the ideal-gas law for a liquid. The agent failed to identify or correct this fundamental physical inconsistency.
